SELECT 'daily_sales' AS source, date::text AS day, units_sold::text AS value1, revenue_inr::text AS value2, NULL::text AS extra
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits', audit_ts::text, status, NULL, NULL
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'inventory_book', date::text, book_on_hand_close::text, NULL, NULL
FROM store.inventory_book
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecasts', date::text, forecast_units_per_day::text, sigma::text,
       'reorder=' || reorder_point || ',up_to=' || order_up_to || ',book=' || book_on_hand || ',ordered=' || ordered_units
FROM store.forecasts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
ORDER BY source, day;

SELECT audit_ts, sku, status
FROM store.shelf_audits
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-25'
  AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-05'
ORDER BY audit_ts;

WITH ds AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date,
         SUM(units_sold) AS units, SUM(revenue_inr) AS revenue
  FROM store.daily_sales
  WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01'
), pl AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(qty) AS units, SUM(line_amount) AS revenue,
         MIN(bill_ts) AS first_ts, MAX(bill_ts) AS last_ts
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
), sa AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS audits,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on shelf') AS on_shelf,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'empty') AS empty,
         MIN(audit_ts) AS first_ts, MAX(audit_ts) AS last_ts
  FROM store.shelf_audits
  WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG'
    AND audit_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT ds.*, pl.lines AS pos_lines, pl.units AS pos_units, pl.revenue AS pos_revenue,
       pl.first_ts AS pos_first_ts, pl.last_ts AS pos_last_ts,
       sa.audits, sa.on_shelf, sa.empty, sa.first_ts AS audit_first_ts, sa.last_ts AS audit_last_ts,
       ROUND(100.0 * sa.on_shelf / NULLIF(sa.audits, 0), 2) AS on_shelf_audit_pct
FROM ds CROSS JOIN pl CROSS JOIN sa;

SELECT 'pos_lines' AS source, MIN(bill_ts)::text AS first_ts, MAX(bill_ts)::text AS last_ts, COUNT(*)::text AS rows
FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'daily_sales', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 'daily_sales_june_29_30', MIN(date)::text, MAX(date)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.daily_sales
WHERE date >= DATE '2026-06-29'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pos_lines_june_29_30', MIN(bill_ts)::text, MAX(bill_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-29'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'shelf_audits_all', MIN(audit_ts)::text, MAX(audit_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.shelf_audits
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stock_counts_atta_5kg', MIN(count_ts)::text, MAX(count_ts)::text, COUNT(*)::text
FROM store.stock_counts
WHERE sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG';

SELECT count_ts, sku, book_before, counted, adjustment, trigger
